# Cascadia Mono, vendored

The mac build ships these files because they are the code face the
Windows build asks for first (`THEME_CODE_FONT`). With the same files
on both systems, code blocks and tables measure the same way, down to
the line breaks.

Source: the `microsoft/cascadia-code` release v2407.24, the static
Cascadia Mono TTFs (Regular, Bold, Italic, Bold Italic), unmodified.
The repo's own License file is kept as `LICENSE-OFL.txt`.
